intent: Productize the exact latest EvoPilot Codex Suite 3.2.1 and DataRig Codex Suite 2.1.5 capabilities into EvoPilot Runtime 5.1.0 through project-neutral independently versioned declarative resources, GovernancePacks, typed Action Providers, bounded autonomous remediation, complete parity and no-regression acceptance, while preserving mandatory published Harness binding, independent evopilot-harness authority, and a separately authorized post-release Suite Cutover.
objective: Deliver Runtime 5.1.0 as the single public Harness-guided governed-evolution execution path whose declarative DDD contracts cover current DataRig and EvoPilot Suite capability baselines without embedding or invoking either Suite; preserve source Suite versions as immutable provenance, let compatible project resources evolve independently of Runtime SemVer, and prove exact installed-Candidate parity, bounded self-repair, owning-human authority, project neutrality, zero hidden fallback, complete inherited compatibility, and NO_REGRESSION.

evidence.authority: Approved Roadmap revision design and exact-latest convergence inventory; authorizes drafting only, not this Target or implementation.
Current authoritative machine Roadmap declaring Runtime 5.1.0 convergence and post-release separate Cutover.
Read-only exact latest Suite baseline and capability differential evidence; advisory until rebound by this Target.
Published Runtime 5.0.1 compatibility and acceptance baseline inherited criterion by criterion.
Exact authority to apply the Roadmap and draft/preflight this Target; not Target approval or implementation authority.

User-confirmed requirement that migrated Suite provenance remains exact, new declarative resources have independent version lines, and compatible resource evolution must not force Runtime version changes; not implementation authority.

include: Freeze and verify exact latest EvoPilot Suite 3.2.1 and DataRig Suite 2.1.5 snapshots, then build a canonical 100-percent capability disposition inventory.
Implement project-neutral declarative DDD resources, GovernancePacks, Action Providers, and release-channel bindings without arbitrary executable YAML or project-name Engine branches.
Define independent resource identity and versioning: apiVersion, resourceVersion or revision, digest, source Suite id/version/digest provenance, and Runtime compatibility range.
Prove compatible project declarations and Pack/Provider resource revisions can evolve, activate, diff, and roll back without changing Runtime or Expert bytes or versions.
Implement bounded autonomous remediation with exact source, Candidate, readiness, lease, evidence, impact, retry, rollback, resume, and stop-rule lineage.
Make one published immutable HarnessBundle binding mandatory and monotonically composed with Lifecycle, provider, policy, environment, credential reference, and authority at every Loop boundary.
Expose the Runtime-owned Human Interaction Protocol and public MCP, HTTP, CLI, CI, and headless contracts required by Expert and third-party Hosts.
Run DataRig, EvoPilot, evopilot-harness, and unknown-project paths as ordinary declarations and prove Suite-free execution.
Refresh the Roadmap-bound v5 completion contract as a derived 5.1 implementation artifact and build an exact 100-percent completion aggregator.
Synchronize README and full technical, operator, migration, security, acceptance, provider, recovery, self-hosting, and resource-versioning documentation.
Prepare shadow and Cutover evidence contracts only; keep both installed Suites untouched until public installation and a separate Cutover Target.
exclude: No copy, import, invocation, packaging, compatibility shim, or hidden fallback to either legacy Suite directory.
No renumbering of DataRig Suite 2.1.5 or EvoPilot Suite 3.2.1 as resource v1; new resource 1.0.0 lines must retain exact immutable Suite provenance.
No lockstep requirement that every declaration, Lifecycle, Policy, GovernancePack, CapabilityPack, or compatible Provider change increments EvoPilot Runtime or Evolution Expert.
No compatibility with superseded EvoPilot Suite or DataRig Suite versions; only exact Target-frozen latest snapshots are migration inputs.
No Harness reasoning, authoring, review, approval, Catalog, Registry, signing, or publication in EvoPilot.
No project-owned Roadmap, Target, credential, database, production, acceptance, or release authority transferred to Runtime.
No actual Suite default switch, disablement, move, archive, uninstall, deletion, or retirement in this Target.
No arbitrary YAML shell execution, hard-coded DataRig/EvoPilot/evopilot-harness Engine branch, or general-purpose coding Agent embedded in Runtime.
No commit, push, Candidate, E2E, Host operation, Suite modification, publication, or Release under an unapproved Target.
